arabic text: SEENE MEIN LIYE RANJ-O-ALAM KARBOBALA KA\nBABA SE HAI MILNE KO CHALI UMME ABIHA\nAANKHON SE LAHOO BEHTA HAI, PEHLU HAI SHIKASTA
english translation text: CARRYING IN HER HEART THE SORROW AND GRIEF OF KARBALA\nUMME ABIHA (AS) HAS SET OUT TO MEET HER FATHER\nBLOOD FLOWS FROM HER EYES, HER SIDE IS BROKEN

arabic text: YA FATEMA ZAHRA, YA UMME ABIHA\nYA FATEMA ZAHRA, PEHLU-E-SHIKASTA
english translation text: O BIBI FATEMA ZAHRA (AS), O UMME ABIHA (AS)\nO BIBI FATEMA ZAHRA (AS), YOU OF THE BROKEN SIDE

arabic text:
UMMAT NE BOHOT AAP KO TADPAAYA HAI BIBI
HAR HAQ KE LIYE AAP KO TARSAAYA HAI BIBI
GHAASIB NE JO DARBAAR MEIN BULWAAYA HAI BIBI
IS DUKH SE LARAZNE LAGA KHUD ARSH KHUDA KA
english translation text:
THE UMMAH HAS MADE YOU SUFFER GREATLY, BIBI
IT HAS KEPT YOU YEARNING FOR EVERY RIGHT, BIBI
THAT THE USURPER SUMMONED YOU TO HIS COURT, BIBI:
AT THIS SORROW, THE THRONE OF GOD ITSELF BEGAN TO TREMBLE

arabic text: YA FATEMA ZAHRA, YA UMME ABIHA\nYA FATEMA ZAHRA, PEHLU-E-SHIKASTA
english translation text: O BIBI FATEMA ZAHRA (AS), O UMME ABIHA (AS)\nO BIBI FATEMA ZAHRA (AS), YOU OF THE BROKEN SIDE

arabic text:
SHABBIR KI DUNYA MEIN WILAADAT SE BHI PEHLE
KEHTI THI YEH ZAHRA KE BOHOT SEHTI HOON SADME
BACHCHA YEH MERA KOKH MEIN BECHAIN BOHOT HAI
BACHCHA MERA KEHTA HAI KE AMMA MAIN HOON PYAASA
english translation text:
EVEN BEFORE SHABBIR (AS) WAS BORN INTO THE WORLD
ZAHRA (AS) WOULD SAY: I BEAR GREAT SORROWS
THIS CHILD OF MINE IS VERY RESTLESS IN MY WOMB
MY CHILD SAYS: MOTHER, I AM THIRSTY

arabic text: YA FATEMA ZAHRA, YA UMME ABIHA\nYA FATEMA ZAHRA, PEHLU-E-SHIKASTA
english translation text: O BIBI FATEMA ZAHRA (AS), O UMME ABIHA (AS)\nO BIBI FATEMA ZAHRA (AS), YOU OF THE BROKEN SIDE

arabic text:
MAA KHAANA KHILAATI HAI TO PHIR KHAATE HAIN BACHCHE
JAATI HAI JAHAAN MAA WAHIN AA JAATE HAIN BACHCHE
BIN MAA KE KABHI CHAIN NAHIN PAATE HAIN BACHCHE
KAAM AATA HAI BACHCHON KE BOHOT MAA KA SAHAARA
english translation text:
WHEN A MOTHER FEEDS THEM, ONLY THEN DO CHILDREN EAT
WHEREVER A MOTHER GOES, THERE THE CHILDREN COME
WITHOUT A MOTHER, CHILDREN NEVER FIND PEACE
A MOTHER'S SUPPORT MEANS SO MUCH TO HER CHILDREN

arabic text: YA FATEMA ZAHRA, YA UMME ABIHA\nYA FATEMA ZAHRA, PEHLU-E-SHIKASTA
english translation text: O BIBI FATEMA ZAHRA (AS), O UMME ABIHA (AS)\nO BIBI FATEMA ZAHRA (AS), YOU OF THE BROKEN SIDE

arabic text:
SEENE MEIN AZAL SE HI MERE KARBOBALA HAI
JAATE HUWE ZAHRA NE YEH DUNYA SE KAHA HAI
KYA SHAAM MEIN HONA HAI, YEH SAB MUJHKO PATA HAI
TAPTE HUWE SEHRA MEIN HAI SHABBIR KA LAASHA
english translation text:
KARBALA HAS BEEN IN MY HEART SINCE THE BEGINNING OF TIME
AS SHE DEPARTED, ZAHRA (AS) SAID THIS TO THE WORLD:
WHAT IS TO HAPPEN IN SHAAM, I KNOW ALL OF IT
IN THE SCORCHING DESERT LIES THE BODY OF SHABBIR (AS)

arabic text: YA FATEMA ZAHRA, YA UMME ABIHA\nYA FATEMA ZAHRA, PEHLU-E-SHIKASTA
english translation text: O BIBI FATEMA ZAHRA (AS), O UMME ABIHA (AS)\nO BIBI FATEMA ZAHRA (AS), YOU OF THE BROKEN SIDE

arabic text:
DUNYA SE CHALI KEHTI HUWI BINT-E-PAYAMBAR
GHAM KARBOBALA KA HAI LIYE YEH DIL-E-MUZTAR
AATA HAI TASAWWUR MEIN MERE SHAAM KA MANZAR
ALLAH RAKHE ZAINAB-O-KULSUM KA PARDA
english translation text:
THE PROPHET'S (SAWW) DAUGHTER LEFT THE WORLD SAYING:
THIS RESTLESS HEART CARRIES THE GRIEF OF KARBALA
THE SCENE OF SHAAM COMES TO MY MIND'S EYE
MAY ALLAH PROTECT THE VEIL OF ZAINAB (SA) AND KULSUM (SA)

arabic text: YA FATEMA ZAHRA, YA UMME ABIHA\nYA FATEMA ZAHRA, PEHLU-E-SHIKASTA
english translation text: O BIBI FATEMA ZAHRA (AS), O UMME ABIHA (AS)\nO BIBI FATEMA ZAHRA (AS), YOU OF THE BROKEN SIDE

arabic text:
YEH KAAM RAHA SADIYON SE BAS AHL-E-AZA KA
PYAASON KE LIYE BEHTA RAHA ASHK KA DARYA
SHABBIR KA PURSA DIYA ZAHRA KO HAMESHA
SHABBIR KO DO MAADAR-E-SHABBIR KA PURSA
english translation text:
FOR CENTURIES THIS HAS BEEN THE ONE WORK OF THE MOURNERS:
FOR THE THIRSTY, A RIVER OF TEARS HAS KEPT FLOWING
THEY HAVE ALWAYS CONSOLED ZAHRA (AS) FOR SHABBIR (AS)
CONSOLE SHABBIR (AS) FOR THE MOTHER OF SHABBIR (AS)

arabic text: YA FATEMA ZAHRA, YA UMME ABIHA\nYA FATEMA ZAHRA, PEHLU-E-SHIKASTA
english translation text: O BIBI FATEMA ZAHRA (AS), O UMME ABIHA (AS)\nO BIBI FATEMA ZAHRA (AS), YOU OF THE BROKEN SIDE

arabic text:
MAAON SE AZAADAARON KI ZAHRA NE KAHA HAI
AASHOOR KE MAQSAD KA BHARAM TUM NE RAKHA HAI
BACHCHON KO AZAADAARI PE QURBAAN KIYA HAI
MEHSHAR MEIN CHUKAAOONGI MAIN QARZA YEH TUMHAARA
english translation text:
ZAHRA (AS) HAS SAID TO THE MOTHERS OF THE MOURNERS:
YOU HAVE KEPT THE HONOUR OF THE PURPOSE OF ASHURA
YOU HAVE SACRIFICED YOUR CHILDREN FOR AZADARI
ON THE DAY OF GATHERING, I WILL REPAY YOU THIS DEBT

arabic text: YA FATEMA ZAHRA, YA UMME ABIHA\nYA FATEMA ZAHRA, PEHLU-E-SHIKASTA
english translation text: O BIBI FATEMA ZAHRA (AS), O UMME ABIHA (AS)\nO BIBI FATEMA ZAHRA (AS), YOU OF THE BROKEN SIDE

arabic text:
AB DIL SE QAMAR WAARIS-E-ZAHRA KO BULAAO
PAAMAALI YEH MARQAD PE BOHOT ASHK BAHAAO
AYE MUNTAQIM-E-KARBOBALA, PARDA UTHAAO
MOHSIN KI LAHAD BAN GAYA PEHLU-E-SHIKASTA
english translation text:
NOW, QAMAR, CALL FROM THE HEART UPON THE HEIR OF ZAHRA (AS)
OVER THIS TRAMPLING OF THE TOMB, SHED MANY TEARS
O AVENGER OF KARBALA, LIFT THE VEIL
THE BROKEN SIDE BECAME THE GRAVE OF MOHSIN (AS)

arabic text: YA FATEMA ZAHRA, YA UMME ABIHA\nYA FATEMA ZAHRA, PEHLU-E-SHIKASTA
english translation text: O BIBI FATEMA ZAHRA (AS), O UMME ABIHA (AS)\nO BIBI FATEMA ZAHRA (AS), YOU OF THE BROKEN SIDE
